title: DARPA's FAR exception and canceled stealth program
summary: John Blitch tells of DARPA's FAR exception and canceled stealth program, about late 1990s at DARPA, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the US military's advanced research agency, says that in the late 1990s he managed 130 million dollars of projects, half robots and half a stealth programme, under an exception to the FAR, the rules that govern how the US government buys things. He says the stealth programme was cancelled a month after it began, for no reason given. He links this to what a general named Trudeau is said to have told an Army officer, Philip Corso, to do, suggesting a pattern of hidden handling of advanced technology.
